cases.title: stack（默认）：组内按 -group 累加，第一个 group 在最上面
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col()

cases.title: stack(reverse = TRUE)：组内按 group 正序累加
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE))

cases.title: stack：负值单独向下堆（ymin/ymax 是相邻累计高度的 min/max）
cases.code: ggplot(negative, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col()

cases.title: fill：stack 之后每个 x 归一到 0..1
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = 'fill')

cases.title: dodge：两组柱并排（width 缺省取柱子宽度，xmin/xmax 由 d_width / n 决定）
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge())

cases.title: dodge(preserve = 'single')：n 取所有 x 上的最大组数（不均匀分组）
cases.code: ggplot(uneven, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(preserve = 'single'))

cases.title: dodge2：按重叠的 x 区间分组 + padding（n 取自每个重叠组）
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge2())

cases.title: dodge2(padding = 0.2)：柱宽按 (1 - padding) 缩进
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge2(padding = 0.2))

cases.title: dodge2(preserve = 'single') 且 data 没有 x：n 取 find_x_overlaps 的重叠组数
cases.code: ggplot(rects, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = g)) + geom_rect(position = position_dodge2(preserve = 'single'))

cases.title: 横向 dodge（flipped_aes = TRUE）：位移作用在 y 上，x 是长度
cases.code: ggplot(horizontal, aes(x = val, y = cat, fill = g)) + geom_col(orientation = 'y', position = position_dodge())

cases.title: 横向 stack（flipped_aes = TRUE）：累计值落在 x 族（长度轴），y 仍是类别轴
cases.code: ggplot(horizontal, aes(x = val, y = cat, fill = g)) + geom_col(orientation = 'y')

cases.title: 横向 fill（flipped_aes = TRUE）：归一后的 y 族写回 x 族，y 保持类别
cases.code: ggplot(horizontal, aes(x = val, y = cat, fill = g)) + geom_col(orientation = 'y', position = 'fill')

cases.title: jitter(seed = 42)：缺省 width/height = 40% resolution（值依赖 R 的 RNG）
nudge(x = 0.2, y = 1)：x / y 族整体平移
cases.code: ggplot(two_groups, aes(x, y, fill = g)) + geom_col(position = position_nudge(x = 0.2, y = 1))
